sources.role: Official festival travel page linking both current 2026 and older 2025 PDFs; only the 2026 timetable is used.
Official branded 2026 extra-bus timetable, page 1 visually inspected; major advertised calls and transfer boundaries, not every GTFS intermediate platform or a precise road itinerary.

note: Service dates are printed dates, not publication dates. After-midnight returns remain attached to the advertised festival evening, using GTFS times above 24:00. The PDF URL version token is not treated as a publication date. PDF creation/modification timestamps are metadata, not verified publication dates.
